info.title: Finance Tracker API — Postman Test Examples
instructions: Step 1 — Run the app: dotnet run
Step 2 — Sign In (request 6) to get your JWT token
Step 3 — Copy the accessToken from the Sign In response
Step 4 — Paste it as: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
Step 5 — For GraphQL requests, send the value inside requests[n].body.query as the POST body JSON
Step 6 — Use expected_response only as a reference for what should come back, not as the request body
Step 7 — If you are using a remote Supabase database, increase Postman Request timeout above 60000ms or set it to 0 (no timeout)
Step 8 — Wait for each request to finish before clicking Send again, otherwise the earlier request may be canceled client-side
Step 9 — Run requests in the testing_order below
info.note: Always copy the id from an Add or GetAll response before running GetById, Update, or Delete. For GraphQL, the request you send is always the JSON object in body, usually with a query property. If you see HTTP 499 in the server logs, the client canceled the request before the API finished.

requests.name: Sign In
requests.description: Copy the accessToken for all GraphQL requests below.

body.query: { incomes { id amount } }

errors.message: The current user is not authorized to access this resource.

requests.name: Add Income
requests.description: Copy the id from the response for GetById, Update, Delete.

body.query: mutation { addIncome(input: { amount: 5000.00, source: "Salary", description: "Monthly salary", date: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z" }) { income { id amount source description date } message errors } }
{ incomes { id amount source description date } }

requests.name: Get Income By Id
requests.description: Paste the id from Add Income or Get All Incomes.

body.query: { income(id: "<PASTE_ID>") { id amount source description date } }

requests.name: Get Income By Id — Not Found
Update Income
requests.description: Paste the id from Add Income. Updates amount, source, description and date.

body.query: mutation { updateIncome(input: { id: "<PASTE_ID>", amount: 5500.00, source: "Salary", description: "Monthly salary - updated", date: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z" }) { income { id amount source description date } message errors } }

requests.name: Update Income — Not Found
requests.description: Should return error when id does not exist.

body.query: mutation { updateIncome(input: { id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", amount: 1000, source: "Test", description: "", date: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z" }) { income { id } message errors } }

requests.name: Delete Income
requests.description: Paste the id from Add Income. Returns success: true on success.

body.query: mutation { deleteIncome(id: "<PASTE_ID>") { success message errors } }

requests.name: Delete Income — Not Found
requests.description: Should return error when id does not exist.

body.query: mutation { deleteIncome(id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000") { success message errors } }

requests.name: Add Expense
requests.description: Copy the id for GetById, Update, Delete.

body.query: mutation { addExpense(input: { amount: 120.50, category: "Groceries", description: "Weekly groceries", date: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z" }) { expense { id amount category description date } message errors } }
{ expenses { id amount category description date } }
{ expense(id: "<PASTE_ID>") { id amount category description date } }

requests.name: Update Expense
requests.description: Paste the id from Add Expense.

body.query: mutation { updateExpense(input: { id: "<PASTE_ID>", amount: 150.00, category: "Groceries", description: "Weekly groceries - updated", date: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z" }) { expense { id amount category description } message errors } }
mutation { deleteExpense(id: "<PASTE_ID>") { success message errors } }

requests.name: Create Savings Goal
requests.description: Copy the id for GetById, Update, AddSavingsContribution, UpdateSavingsProgress, and Delete.

body.query: mutation { createSavingsGoal(input: { name: "Emergency Fund", targetAmount: 10000.00, deadline: "2025-12-31T00:00:00Z" }) { savingsGoal { id name targetAmount currentAmount remainingAmount progress deadline } message errors } }
{ savingsGoals { id name targetAmount currentAmount remainingAmount progress deadline } }
{ savingsGoal(id: "<PASTE_ID>") { id name targetAmount currentAmount remainingAmount progress deadline } }

requests.name: Update Savings Goal
requests.description: Updates name, targetAmount and deadline. Cannot set targetAmount below currentAmount. Query remainingAmount if you want the updated balance left to save.

body.query: mutation { updateSavingsGoal(input: { id: "<PASTE_ID>", name: "Emergency Fund - Updated", targetAmount: 15000.00, deadline: "2026-06-30T00:00:00Z" }) { savingsGoal { id name targetAmount deadline } message errors } }

requests.name: Add Savings Contribution
requests.description: Adds a contribution amount to the current saved balance. Use this for normal contributions toward the goal.

body.query: mutation { addSavingsContribution(input: { id: "<PASTE_ID>", amount: 2500.00 }) { savingsGoal { id name currentAmount targetAmount remainingAmount progress } message errors } }

requests.name: Update Savings Progress
requests.description: Sets the total saved amount directly. Use this when you want to correct or override the saved balance. Query remainingAmount if you also want the amount still left to save.

body.query: mutation { updateSavingsProgress(id: "<PASTE_ID>", newAmount: 6500.00) { savingsGoal { id name currentAmount targetAmount remainingAmount progress } message errors } }
mutation { deleteSavingsGoal(id: "<PASTE_ID>") { success message errors } }

requests.name: Add Loan — Owed
requests.description: Copy the id for GetById, Update, Repayment, History, Settle, and Delete. counterpartyPhoneNumber is optional and useful when the mobile app chooses a person from contacts.

body.query: mutation { addLoan(input: { counterpartyName: "John Smith", counterpartyPhoneNumber: "+256700000000", amount: 2000.00, type: OWED, description: "Personal loan", date: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z", dueDate: "2025-06-01T00:00:00Z" }) { loan { id counterpartyName counterpartyPhoneNumber amount amountRepaid remainingBalance type isSettled dueDate } message errors } }
{ loans { id counterpartyName counterpartyPhoneNumber amount amountRepaid remainingBalance type isSettled date dueDate } }
{ loan(id: "<PASTE_ID>") { id counterpartyName counterpartyPhoneNumber amount amountRepaid remainingBalance type isSettled date dueDate } }

requests.name: Update Loan
requests.description: Updates counterpartyName, optional counterpartyPhoneNumber, amount, description and dueDate. Type remains unchanged. The new amount cannot be less than amountRepaid, so if amountRepaid is 300.00 the smallest valid amount is 300.00.

body.query: mutation { updateLoan(input: { id: "<PASTE_ID>", counterpartyName: "John Smith", counterpartyPhoneNumber: "+256711111111", amount: 2500.00, description: "Updated description", dueDate: "2025-09-01T00:00:00Z" }) { loan { id counterpartyName counterpartyPhoneNumber amount amountRepaid remainingBalance description dueDate } message errors } }

mutation { recordRepayment(input: { loanId: "<PASTE_ID>", amount: 500.00, date: "2025-02-01T00:00:00Z", note: "First repayment" }) { loan { id amount amountRepaid remainingBalance isSettled status } message errors } }
mutation { recordRepayment(input: { loanId: "<PASTE_ID>", amount: 999999.00 }) { loan { id } message errors } }

errors: Repayment amount exceeds the remaining balance of $1,500.00.

body.query: mutation { deleteLoan(id: "<PASTE_ID>") { success message errors } }
{ dashboard { totalIncome totalExpenses netBalance savingsProgress { id name targetAmount currentAmount remainingAmount progress } loanSummary { totalOwed totalGiven } } }
{ health }

requests.name: Get Incomes — Filtered By Date And Source
requests.description: Shows the new optional income filters. Useful for dashboards, monthly reports, or source-specific views.

body.query: { incomes(fromDate: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z", toDate: "2025-01-31T23:59:59Z", source: "Salary") { id amount source description date } }

requests.name: Get Expenses — Filtered By Date And Category
requests.description: Shows the new optional expense filters. Useful for category-based spending reviews.

body.query: { expenses(fromDate: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z", toDate: "2025-01-31T23:59:59Z", category: "Groceries") { id amount category description date } }

requests.name: Get Loans — Filtered By Type
requests.description: Shows the optional loan type filter. Useful when the UI wants liabilities and assets separately.

body.query: { loans(type: OWED) { id counterpartyName counterpartyPhoneNumber amount amountRepaid remainingBalance type isSettled date dueDate } }

requests.name: Get Loans — Filtered By Status
requests.description: Shows the optional loan status filter. Useful for screens like Active, Settled, or Overdue loans.

body.query: { loans(status: ACTIVE) { id counterpartyName amount amountRepaid remainingBalance type isSettled status dueDate } }

requests.name: Get Loan Repayment History
requests.description: Returns repayment history events for a specific loan, newest first.

body.query: { loanRepaymentHistory(loanId: "<PASTE_ID>") { id amount date note createdAt } }

requests.name: Settle Loan
requests.description: Repays the full remaining balance and records a final repayment history event.

body.query: mutation { settleLoan(input: { loanId: "<PASTE_ID>", date: "2025-03-01T00:00:00Z", note: "Settled in full" }) { loan { id amount amountRepaid remainingBalance isSettled status } message errors } }

requests.name: GraphQL Sign Up
requests.description: Reference example for the public GraphQL signUp mutation. REST sign-up remains the main onboarding flow in this file.

body.query: mutation { signUp(input: { email: "graphql.user@example.com", password: "Password123!" }) { message errors } }

signUp.message: Account created successfully. Please sign in.

requests.name: GraphQL Sign In
requests.description: Reference example for the public GraphQL signIn mutation.

body.query: mutation { signIn(input: { email: "graphql.user@example.com", password: "Password123!" }) { signIn { accessToken refreshToken tokenType } errors } }

requests.name: Update Loan — Amount Below Repaid
requests.description: Run this after Record Repayment. If amountRepaid is 500.00, updating the loan amount to 400.00 should fail.

body.query: mutation { updateLoan(input: { id: "<PASTE_ID>", counterpartyName: "John Smith", counterpartyPhoneNumber: "+256711111111", amount: 400.00, description: "Too low after repayment", dueDate: "2025-09-01T00:00:00Z" }) { loan { id amount amountRepaid remainingBalance } message errors } }

errors: Amount cannot be less than the amount already repaid ($500.00).
